How Poppy fixes itself.

Before you see an app, Poppy runs it silently in a sandbox. If something breaks, it reads the error, writes its own repair prompt and patches the code. Break one below and watch.

Describe it. Watch it bloom.

5.0 stays the root: one file, one SDK, one verify probe. Everything else grows from there.
